description: This source file defines an interface and a struct related to environment statistics in the Orleans framework. The interface `IEnvironmentStatisticsProvider` provides a method to retrieve current environment statistics, while the `EnvironmentStatistics` struct encapsulates various metrics like CPU usage, memory consumption, and available memory, with filtering and formatting logic.

classes.name: EnvironmentStatistics
classes.description: Immutable struct that holds detailed statistics about system CPU and memory usage, including filtered and raw values, with methods for formatted output and calculated percentages.

methods.name: GetEnvironmentStatistics
methods.description: Interface method to retrieve current environment statistics, potentially with filtering applied.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Returns a human-readable string summarizing CPU and memory usage statistics.
